name: NEC Cross Country Championships
headline: NEC Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Stonehill swept the team titles, ending Central Connecticut's run of women's titles. The Stonehill women scored 39 points to Central Connecticut's 48 and Le Moyne's 113, with CCSU's Mya Morabito winning the race in 21:17.8 over Stonehill's Jordan Malloy (21:24.3). The Stonehill men scored 33 to Central Connecticut's 77 and Le Moyne's 114 (FDU 115), and CCSU's Aidan Budge won the individual title in 23:47.5.
